name: Onan
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Judah lay with a Canaanite woman, which was forbidden, and had Er, Onan and Shelah; our forefathers were not the most righteous men in the world.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Onan was told to go in unto his brother's wife and raise up seed to his brother, and he refused, spilling it on the ground, and the Lord slew him also.
Onan knew the seed would not be his, so he spilled it on the ground rather than give his brother an heir, and the Lord slew him; this verse alone proves that seed is sperm.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: The sons of Judah are named: Er, Onan, and Shelah, born to him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess, and then Perez and Zerah, born to him of Tamar his daughter-in-law.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 2: The Sons of Israel and the Line of Judah
